scope: Selected ring-torus exchange and the native/scalar facts required by repeated exact composition. Final source and cost retention are bound separately by retention-decision.json and manifest.json.

ideas.idea: Expose borrowed native torus geometry and map selected circular torus boundaries through STEP
ideas.reason: Extends exact exchange to the declared ring-torus domain, with independent analytic measures, graph checks, units, source maps, periodic seams and downstream composition. New complete workloads have absolute costs; previously unsupported export is not a speedup baseline.

ideas.idea: Retain a planar intersection's certified affine preimage for incident pcurves
ideas.reason: Preserves an already certified construction fact without changing the canonical edge root or reconstructing the contact in an adapter.

ideas.idea: Apply that affine-preimage representation choice to every intersected surface family
ideas.reason: Broke preserved sphere/torus archive replay. The retained condition is restricted to planar cuts; a broader change needs its own composition proof and qualification.

ideas.idea: Normalize an affine split parameter through Hyperreal's existing exact rational projection
ideas.reason: Removes a certified rational quotient before subdividing pcurves. Unrecognized and nonrational parameters remain unchanged. No scalar reducer is duplicated in BREP.

ideas.idea: Accept a positive same-frame, same-phase complete circle-map proof before expanded rotated-frame proofs
ideas.reason: Exact domain, center, radius, direction, frame and phase equalities establish the whole parameterized map. Unavailable certificates retain the previous proof paths.

ideas.idea: Recover periodic endpoint lifts from exact sine and cosine equality
ideas.reason: A positive congruence certificate and the validated at-most-one-turn chart identify endpoint preimages, including both seam ends. Reversal, ellipses, distant phases and exact near-endpoint controls are retained.

ideas.idea: Resolve repeated replay with a nine-multiplier BREP trigonometric cascade
ideas.reason: The second subdivision still failed. The shared scalar normal form is the sufficient owner; the attempted BREP cascade was removed.

ideas.idea: Generalize the existing principal-angle normal form in Hyperreal
ideas.reason: Exact rational sine roots, signed principal branches, complementary first-quadrant acos arguments and the existing bounded Laurent projection certify the actual serialized second-split phase. Scalar correctness and downstream tests are separate from the supplementary microcost observations; adverse costs remain in the final retention decision.

ideas.idea: Remove every native fact after repairing the shared scalar proof
ideas.reason: Distant endpoint lifting, archive subdivision and independently expressed area still failed. The retained native facts and scalar certificate are required together by the completed original workflows.

ideas.idea: Use native whole-edge image and solid admission as the adapter's authority
ideas.reason: The STEP adapter supplies candidate charts and source maps to the existing native proofs. It does not need a second geometric kernel, endpoint-only acceptance or an external production kernel.

ideas.idea: Prove the newly completed rational torus sector's volume after dividing both exact sides by positive pi
ideas.reason: The nonzero positive divisor is separately certified, so this proves the original equation. The direct unscaled comparison remains unresolved; failed attempts and original full-size geometry are retained.

ideas.idea: Use pi normalization alone to prove aggregate area after every repeated torus subdivision
ideas.reason: The aggregate comparison still remained undecided after the first subdivision. It is not accepted as an equality certificate.

ideas.idea: Prove area preservation by the independent initial total and every exact component-area equality
ideas.reason: Equal face counts and all nine pairwise area equalities at each of four cycles imply equality of the total by additivity and induction. This also rejects compensating component errors. Four unresolved aggregate comparisons remain recorded, with no new public scalar-certificate claim.

ideas.idea: Retain incidental formatting throughout the included scalar implementation fragment
ideas.reason: Removed 33 unrelated formatting hunks. Canonical rustfmt output is byte-identical, and final release/minimal consumers, focused scalar tests, warning checks, boundaries and measured binaries use the reduced patch.

ideas.idea: Repair inherited unrelated scalar debug failures as part of this BREP feature
ideas.reason: The zero-factor failure reproduces on baseline and candidate and is owned by the concurrent thread. Supporting feature changes are permitted in their owning crates; this separate failure is not required to implement the selected BREP contract.

ideas.idea: Encode future exact cone exchange through a STEP surface of revolution
ideas.reason: Research for a separate increment, not an implemented or measured capability here. Projective line direction, slant parameters, positive-nappe restriction, apex strata and interoperability need their own exact admission.

ideas.idea: Admit the five canonical archive-expression changes through complete exact comparison
ideas.owner: Native affine contact and split representations; explicit archive migration review
ideas.reason: All 173 complete archive pairs are bound to all three timed trials. 113 pairs are byte-identical; 60 differ only in 238 pcurve start-coordinate scalars that each pass direct strict equality. Every non-scalar field agrees and both versions of changed archives revalidate. Preserve the original failed no-migration gate, 162 unchanged receipts, all old/new artifacts and adverse costs. This explicit feature migration is not an unchanged-byte optimization or approval for further changes.
